```{r}
source("analysis/scripts/leaf_drop.r")

results <-analyse_leafdrop(
    "raw", 
    annotate = "none",
    rename_strains = c(
        "Guy11" = "Guy11",
        "ham5_1.95" = "Δham5_1.95",
        "ham5_27.2" = "Δham5_27.2"
    ),
    base_size=8,
)
results$plot
```

```{r}
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "figures/ham5_leafdrop_lesion_area_plot.svg",
  plot = results$plot,

)
```
